h1.en: Electric 10 vs Electric 20 Concrete Pump: 15 kW beside the DC motor article
h1.zh: 电动10和电动20混凝土泵有何不同：对照「直流电动机」时，15 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Electric 10 Series and Electric 20 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 10 lists 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³ and horizontal distance 25 m, with no vertical entry. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor.
directAnswer.zh: 电动10系列和电动20是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动10标出 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、水平距离 25 m，没有垂直格。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor. The picture shows DC motor. Electric 10 Series and Electric 20 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Motor power: Electric 10 Series lists 15 kW. Electric 20 lists 22 kW. Max. aggregate size: Electric 10 Series lists 2 cm and below. Electric 20 lists 1–2 cm. Electric 10 Series lists entries that Electric 20 does not: Horizontal pumping distance 25 m. One does not imply the other. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor。画面是DC motor。电动10系列和电动20是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电机功率：电动10系列标出 15 kW；电动20标出 22 kW。最大骨料粒径：电动10系列标出 2 cm and below；电动20标出 1–2 cm。电动20有、电动10系列没有的行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 40 m；输送管内径 80 mm。

body.en: Electric 10 lists 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³ and horizontal distance 25 m, with no vertical entry. Theoretical output: Electric 10 Series lists 21 m³/h. Electric 20 lists 8–10 m³/h. Dimensions: Electric 10 Series lists 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Electric 20 lists 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. Electric 20 lists entries that Electric 10 Series does not: Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 40 m. Delivery pipe diameter 80 mm. Open /en/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/ for Electric 10 Series and /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ for Electric 20.
body.zh: 电动10标出 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、水平距离 25 m，没有垂直格。理论输送量：电动10系列标出 21 m³/h；电动20标出 8–10 m³/h。外形尺寸：电动10系列标出 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm；电动20标出 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm。看电动10系列请打开 /zh/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/，看电动20请打开 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Electric 20 lists 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³ and distance 120 m / 40 m. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 10 Series lists 23 MPa. Electric 20 lists 10 MPa. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电动20标出 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、料斗 0.25 m³、距离 120 m / 40 m。最大出口压力：电动10系列标出 23 MPa；电动20标出 10 MPa。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Higher theoretical output on Electric 10 is not a longer distance entry. Hopper capacity: Electric 10 Series lists 0.1 m³. Electric 20 lists 0.25 m³. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Compare output and distance as separate columns. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 电动10更高的理论输送量并不是更长的距离格。料斗容积：电动10系列标出 0.1 m³；电动20标出 0.25 m³。电动10系列有、电动20没有的行：水平输送距离 25 m。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series list the same motor power as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动20的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series lists 15 kW. Electric 20 lists 22 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列标出 15 kW。电动20标出 22 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series list the same theoretical output as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动20的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series lists 21 m³/h. Electric 20 lists 8–10 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列标出 21 m³/h。电动20标出 8–10 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series lists 23 MPa. Electric 20 lists 10 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列标出 23 MPa。电动20标出 10 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is horizontal pumping distance missing on Electric 20?
question.zh: 为什么电动20没有水平输送距离？

answer.en: The Electric 20 page does not list that label. Electric 10 Series lists 25 m. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor.
answer.zh: 电动20这一页没有标出这个标题。电动10系列标出的是 25 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DC_motor画面里印出的数字。
